title: a page under docs/reviews/ no longer pulls a property test into the docs-only cross-card run (the integrator's red of 2026-11-22)
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the CI job logs read (public, no token), the local runs written on the card page and the card's tests.

findings.claim: the docs-only selection (tools/ci_docs_only.py, D-969) pulls a test in when a docstring or comment cites the changed document; the folder match is narrowed here (a folder is named by itself, not by another document in it), but a change to a cited page, such as docs/reviews/2026-11-12-architecture/decision.md, still selects both tests/property files; matching only code strings needs ast, which the tool's standard-library test does not list

the world fixture of tests/property/test_path_independence.py is module-scoped and shared through a file lock; under --dist worksteal a worker that comes back to the module asked for it again and, after a failed build, built again into its own build-<pid> folder (FileExistsError on sec), hiding the first error; fixed here (a folder per attempt, the first failure raised again); other shared builds of this shape were not looked for

the cross-card job runs the docs-only list without fonts or JVM (jobs 137168755036, 137169956446, 137186838469: font NotoSansTC-Regular.ttf not found); a selected test that needs them cannot pass there
